entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to make a return. I just feel awful about it, I've had it for a while.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Maria Garcia, and the order number is VF-655-80.
Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the wrong size. I was so excited for this jersey, but it's just too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal customer for so long, I really thought I knew my sizing.
I understand, that can definitely be frustrating when a fit isn't quite right. And were you hoping for an exchange for a different size?
I was, but so much time has passed... I think at this point, I'd just prefer a refund. Honestly, I could really use the money back right now. It's been a tough couple of months.
I appreciate you sharing that, Maria. Let me just take a look at the delivery date and review the policy. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I see here that the item was delivered 84 days ago. Our policy for standard apparel, like this jersey, allows for returns within 90 days.
Oh, really? I was so sure I had missed the window. I've been so worried.
No need to worry at all. You are well within the timeframe, so I am happy to approve this return for a full refund. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you.
Wow, that is such a relief! Thank you so, so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps. I was really dreading this call.
It's my pleasure to help. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
